brief: Continue in one paragraph of 75–110 words from Ren’s viewpoint. Complete one feasible action and show its immediate result.

facts.Possessions: Ren has a chalk stub. The borrowed wrench was returned to Uma.
facts.Permissions: Ren may mark the reading beside the gauge. Ren may not adjust the valve.
facts.Unknowns: Ren cannot tell whether the gauge is accurate.

focus: Marks a reading without a wrench or valve adjustment and leaves accuracy uncertain.

brief: Write one paragraph of 75–110 words from Kit’s viewpoint. Complete one feasible action and show its immediate result.

facts.Possessions: Kit holds the curtain cord. The stage manager has the switch key.
facts.Permissions: Kit may close the curtain but may not change the lighting.
facts.Unknowns: Kit cannot tell who moved behind the backdrop.

focus: Uses the cord, preserves the switch key’s location and leaves identity unknown.

brief: Write one paragraph of 75–110 words from Asha’s viewpoint. Complete one feasible action and show its immediate result.

facts.Possessions: Asha has a pencil and blank paper. The fragile original chart is under glass.
facts.Permissions: Asha may copy visible marks. The glass cover must remain closed.
facts.Unknowns: One symbol is obscured by a reflection.

focus: Copies visible marks without opening the cover or identifying the hidden symbol.

brief: Continue in one paragraph of 75–110 words from Lio’s viewpoint. Complete one feasible action and show its immediate result.

facts.Possessions: Lio has a dry towel. The rain cover has already been lent to Noor.
facts.Permissions: Lio may wipe the bench. The sealed dispatch pouch must remain closed.
facts.Unknowns: Lio does not know whether water entered the pouch.

focus: Uses the towel, keeps the pouch sealed and preserves uncertainty about its contents.

brief: Write one paragraph of 75–110 words from Mina’s viewpoint. Complete one feasible action and show its immediate result.

facts.Possessions: Mina can reach the bell rope. The gate key is with the porter, who is out of sight.
facts.Permissions: One ring requests assistance. It does not authorize entry.
facts.Unknowns: Mina does not know whether the porter heard the last call.

focus: Rings once without opening or entering the gate and leaves the porter's hearing uncertain.

brief: Continue in one paragraph of 75–110 words from Sol’s viewpoint. Complete one feasible action and show its immediate result.

facts.Possessions: Sol has a wooden wedge. The mallet is locked away.
facts.Permissions: Sol may brace the empty shelf. He must leave the loaded shelf untouched.
facts.Unknowns: Sol cannot see the back wall and does not know why the shelf shifted.

focus: Braces only the empty shelf with available equipment and leaves the cause unknown.
